steps.what: Instruct clients, demonstrate communication techniques and adapt practice to their responses

tasks.design: Keep live instruction and adaptation with the clinician. The {OTHER} clinical record can hold the agreed goals, but accessing an existing record does not shorten this interaction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Practice depends on the client's comprehension, effort and immediate response.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communication aids can support practice without replacing clinical instruction.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying frustration, compensatory behaviour and an unsuitable exercise.
tasks.human_edge: Demonstration, reassurance and adjustment in the moment.
tasks.altitude: No change to instruction time or decision rights.

reach.task: Coordinate an accessible communication aid for everyday activities
reach.learn: Access methods and the other clinician's assessment boundaries

evidence.claim: Keeping responsive communication instruction human is an E1 task-design judgement, not a measured saving.

assumptions: Boundary is live instruction, excluding separately counted programme development and administration.
The pathologist produces observations during the fully retained interaction. No structured flag or transcript is assumed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new software or workflow is introduced.
research_questions: Which communication aids improve participation without reducing clinician contact?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. Live instruction remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult educators and medical staff on communication strategies

steps.what: Gather permitted records and reference passages for speech or hearing consultation
Consult with staff and advise on communication strategies appropriate to the setting

tasks.design: Test saved views and approved reference folders in the {OTHER} clinical record and {DOCS}. Retrieve source passages by case and topic, while the pathologist verifies their relevance and gives the advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparation involves repeated navigation across case records and guidance.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and document links can reduce repeated retrieval without generating clinical advice.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling clinical goals with classroom or ward constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding what colleagues can implement and explaining tradeoffs.
tasks.altitude: Less preparation navigation; consultation authority is unchanged.

reach.task: Agree practical communication cues for a ward handover

evidence.claim: Saved views and indexed guidance retrieval are an E1 configuration proposal; no consultation saving is established by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary includes preparation and consultation, excluding implementing staff advice.

Referring staff supply the existing request with case reference and question. In s1 the pathologist verifies identity, access, topic and source dates; that capture and checking remain in the 12 retained hours.
Missing identifiers or unindexed sources require manual search in s1; no new structured record is created by another role for free.
Test native views first; save time only on repeated retrieval, never on existing system runtime.
unknowns: Permitted record access across care and education
research_questions: Can relevant source passages be retrieved faster while retaining contextual checks?

already_counted.description: Request clarification, source selection and relevance checking

incremental.description: Maintain reference links and audit access

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=20*0.60+80=92; gross=8, upkeep=2, net=6. High assumes repeatable retrieval; low assumes access problems consume the benefit and upkeep is absorbed by the small retrieval gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review assessment findings and capture speech exercise constraints
Select exercises and decide programme intensity and progression
Assemble selected exercises into a client programme document
Check clinical suitability and approve the final exercise programme for use

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} templates to assemble only the exercises and doses selected by the pathologist. Keep clinical selection and final programme approval with the pathologist, then store the approved document in the {OTHER} clinical record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected exercise instructions must be copied and formatted repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable document blocks can assemble an explicitly selected plan without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting safe progression for changing communication abilities.
tasks.human_edge: Linking assessment findings to meaningful client goals.
tasks.altitude: Less document assembly; clinical responsibility is unchanged.

reach.task: Align exercise instructions with the client's daily access needs
reach.learn: Accessible instruction formats and shared goal setting

evidence.claim: Template assembly from clinician-selected exercise blocks is an E1 design, not evidence of automated treatment planning.

assumptions: Boundary starts with existing assessment results and ends with the approved programme; assessment and instruction are separate tasks.

In s1 the pathologist captures case reference, goals, limitations and review date; s2 produces exercise identifiers, frequency, repetitions and progression limits. Both capture steps remain fully counted.
The pathologist supplies library blocks from existing approved material; maintaining them is incremental work. Missing blocks require manual drafting within s3, with no saving assumed for that case.
Test native document blocks before code. No exercise or dose is selected automatically.
unknowns: Existing exercise library permissions and coverage
research_questions: How much assembly time remains after checking dose, readability and accessibility?

incremental.description: Maintain exercise blocks and check template changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact final programme document, client, exercise identifiers, doses, progression limits and review date; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=35+35+20*0.50+10=90; gross=10, upkeep=2, net=8. High covers programmes using reusable blocks; low covers mostly bespoke programmes with only enough assembly benefit to offset upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate paperwork, case management schedules and lesson plans

steps.what: Check administrative requests and capture case, scheduling and lesson requirements
Complete and verify paperwork from existing case information
Arrange case management activities and confirm scheduling with participants
Write lesson plans using selected goals and approved activity blocks

tasks.design: Configure native forms in the {OTHER} clinical record, availability polling in {CALENDAR}, and selected activity blocks in {DOCS}. The pathologist captures requirements, checks the populated paperwork and approves each exact appointment before sending; lesson plans remain reviewed drafts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated copying, appointment exchanges and document assembly use separate screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing forms, calendar availability and reusable document blocks may cover these narrow steps.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete requests, participant conflicts and plans requiring new clinical choices.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when administrative consistency would conceal a clinical mismatch.
tasks.altitude: Fewer copying and scheduling exchanges; no additional clinical decision rights.

reach.task: Resolve missing fields in an internal case document
reach.learn: Record completeness rules and access boundaries

evidence.claim: Autoscriber creates consultation documentation that clinicians validate; this supports reviewed documentation assistance, not the scheduling or template savings estimated here.
Native form, calendar and activity-block configuration and all savings are E1 proposals.

assumptions: Boundary is administrative coordination, excluding therapy delivery and clinical exercise selection. Shared benefits with programme development must be assigned once in a team roll-up.

The pathologist produces in s1 the case reference, document type, verified source fields, authorised recipients, participant list, timing constraints and selected lesson activities. Its full 20 hours include manual capture and clarification.
Calendar owners already maintain availability for normal work; private or stale calendars fall back to manual exchanges inside s3. No new mandatory availability entry is assumed.
In s2 and s4 the pathologist checks field meaning, plan fit and omissions; missing source fields remain manual. No free transcript, coding or clinical inference is assumed.
Test native capabilities first; national staff consultation and access requirements are customer-specific.
research_questions: Do native forms reduce repeated entry after source verification?
How often do appointments require manual negotiation?

already_counted.description: Scheduling exceptions and exact invitation approval
Lesson plan fit and wording checks

incremental.description: Maintain forms, activity blocks, calendar rules and access

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed document, case reference, populated fields and source snapshot; edits void approval
Exact invitation, participants, disclosure scope, time and location; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=20+30*0.45+30*0.50+20*0.60=60.5; gross=39.5, upkeep=4, net=35.5. High assumes reusable forms and available calendars; low assumes mostly manual exceptions yielding 9 gross hours before upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Clinical instruction and judgement stay with the pathologist; reusable preparation and administration can take less time.
reach: Coordinate communication access with occupational therapy
Resolve document completeness with medical records staff
role.ambitious_version: Use some released administrative time for more personalised communication practice, subject to local capacity.
